title: This Shrimp Punches At Highway Speed
description:
The mantis shrimp's club strike is one of the fastest in the animal world: the species Gonodactylus smithii has been recorded at 30.6 m/s (110 km/h), and Odontodactylus scyllarus accelerates its club at about 10,400 g from a standing start. The strike creates cavitation bubbles that collapse and hit the prey a second time, on top of an impact force of about 1,500 newtons.

Source: Wikipedia, 'Mantis shrimp'. The car and boxing gloves are jokes.

Which animal has the best superpower? Tell us in the comments.
